page.overview:
What is Adropiae?

The Adropiae were an avian-humanoid species. In the late 32nd century, at least one Adropiae served in Starfleet. () The name of the species was not spoken on screen, but was given as the production name for the species on Instagram by makeup department head Shauna Llewellyn.
